stem: Why does the poet include stanzas 3 and 4?

options.label: A
options.text: To suggest that travel by wagon had both advantages and disadvantages

options.label: B
options.text: To explain why pioneers wanted to cross the prairie by wagon

options.label: C
options.text: To describe what a covered wagon could carry

options.label: D
options.text: To prove that traveling by wagon was more fun than air travel
